title: Velocity selector: where the two forces balance
caption: For a charge q the electric force is qE and the magnetic force is qvB. Per unit charge, E = 2 × 10⁴ V m⁻¹ does not depend on speed while vB = 0.1v rises with it. They cancel, and the particle goes straight through, only at v = E/B = 20000/0.1 = 2 × 10⁵ m s⁻¹. Slower particles are pushed along E; faster ones along the magnetic force.
alt: Graph of force per unit charge against speed: a flat line at 2 (units of 10⁴ V m⁻¹) for the electric force and a rising line vB through the origin, crossing at 2 × 10⁵ m s⁻¹.
description: The horizontal axis is the particle's speed in units of 10⁵ m s⁻¹; the vertical axis is force per unit charge in units of 10⁴ V m⁻¹.
The electric force per charge is E = 2 (×10⁴ V m⁻¹), the same at every speed.
The magnetic force per charge vB = 0.1v rises from zero in proportion to the speed.
The lines cross at v = 2 × 10⁵ = 200000 m s⁻¹: only particles of this speed are undeflected.
